hooks.command: bash -c 'LAST_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%s 2>/dev/null); if echo "$LAST_MSG" | grep -qoE "\[ZEN-[0-9]+\]"; then echo "zensu: feature reference detected in commit: $(echo "$LAST_MSG" | grep -oE "\[ZEN-[0-9]+\]" | tr "\n" " ")"; fi'

bash -c 'HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) && echo "zensu: pulse session ready — HEAD=$HEAD branch=$BRANCH" || echo "zensu: not a git repository, pulse session skipped"'
